scene_templates.name: 旅行摄影风格历史场景
scene_templates.description: 生成真实的旅行摄影风格历史场景，适合作为自拍背景
scene_templates.template: A realistic travel photo, as if taken by a traveler with a handheld camera, street-level perspective, [historical location] as it looked in [year]. Local people in traditional clothing of that era, daily life on the street, buildings and landmarks clearly visible, cinematic natural lighting, slightly weathered travel photography look, film grain. Good composition for a selfie background with open space in the foreground.

scene_templates.name: 纪录片风格历史场景
scene_templates.description: 专业纪录片级别的历史场景重现，注重历史准确性
scene_templates.template: A professional documentary-style historical photograph of [historical location] in [year]. Authentic period architecture, people in accurate historical clothing, bustling daily activities typical of the era. Museum-quality historical accuracy, natural lighting, rich detail showing the social structure and urban life of the time. Composition suitable for educational or documentary purposes.

scene_templates.template: An artistic historical painting of [historical location] during [year], rendered in the style of classical historical paintings.
